summary.en: Consider spectral, spatial and temporal information as additional descriptions.
summary.zh-cn: 把光谱、空间与时间信息作为额外描述。

boundary.en: Infrared, depth, event and line-scan describe different measurement approaches, not positions on a consumer-camera ladder.
boundary.zh-cn: 红外、深度、事件与线扫描描述不同测量方式，不是消费相机的优劣等级。
